fullContentHtml:
UPSSSC PET Revised Exam Date 2026 – Full Details

Uttar Pradesh Subordinate Service Selection Commission (UPSSSC) has released the revised exam date for the UPSSSC Preliminary Examination Test (PET). Applications for the UPSSSC Preliminary Examination Test (PET) 2026 were accepted from 03 August 2026 to 07 September 2026. The examination is going to conducted on 25,30 October 2026 & 01 November 2026. Candidates who had applied this form can download their UPSSSC PET Exam Date 2026 from the link

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 3 August 2026
  • Last Date : 07 September 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 07 September 2026
  • Form Correction Date : 08 September 2026
  • Exam Date : 25, 30 October 2026 & 01 November 2026
  • Admit Card : Before Exam
  • Candidates must go to the Important Links section below
  • Then the candidates must click on the exam date link.
  • After clicking on the link, the candidates will be redirected to a new page.
  • In this page, candidates have to enter the following details:
  • Registration no.
  • Login ID
  • Birth Date/Password
  • Captcha Code
  • Then the candidates have to submit the details by clicking on the Login button.

Application Fee

  • General, OBC : Rs. 185/-
  • SC, ST : Rs. 95/-
  • PH : Rs. 25/-

How to Apply Online

  1. Click on the direct Apply Online link in the Important Links section below.
  2. Complete new registration with your Name, Email, and Mobile Number.
  3. Fill the application form with personal, educational, and address details.
  4. Upload scanned photograph, signature, and required certificates.
  5. Pay the applicable examination fee online and download the submission receipt.
